title: Diagnostic reliability of endomyocardial biopsy for assessment of cardiac allograft rejection
study_context: Historical cardiac-allograft study using autopsy-acquired specimens to assess endomyocardial biopsy rejection grading.
population_or_data: Historical cardiac-allograft study using autopsy-acquired specimens to assess endomyocardial biopsy rejection grading.
task: Historical cardiac-allograft study using autopsy-acquired specimens to assess endomyocardial biopsy rejection grading.
method: Comparison of inflammation-pattern and myocyte-necrosis criteria with attention to biopsy fragment number.
main_findings: Autopsy-acquired cardiac allografts were used to examine biopsy grading reliability as a function of the morphological diagnostic criterion and the number of fragments.
limitations: Abstract-only review. PDF pages 1 and extracted text visually checked on 2026-10-07.
Abstract-only review; no numerical error rate indexed. Historical criteria are not modern 0R-3R labels. Not a biopsy/autopsy AI training experiment.
does_not_establish: Abstract-only review; no numerical error rate indexed. Historical criteria are not modern 0R-3R labels. Not a biopsy/autopsy AI training experiment.
relevance_to_project: A direct rejection-specific precedent for studying small-biopsy sampling using larger autopsy material.
